title: DECISION: eager idempotent provision on every JMAP request
description: provision_user_mailboxes is called on every authenticated JMAP method dispatch, not just at account creation time. The INSERT OR IGNORE implementation makes it a no-op after the first call. This means there is no window where a user account exists but their special folders do not — the folders are guaranteed present before any Mailbox/get or Email/query handler runs. Alternative rejected: provisioning only during user creation in the admin path. That approach creates a race: a message could be delivered via SMTP between account creation and first JMAP login, and the INBOX lookup in sieve_delivery would find no row, triggering the fallback warning. Tradeoff: one extra DB round-trip per JMAP request at steady state, but SQLite makes this essentially free.
